items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Never played any of it, no.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of these Henry Fillmore trombone pieces? Like, Lassus' trombone, Miss Trombone? No, I never played none of that stuff. Never played none of that stuff.
Never played any of it, no.
Did you ever play Josh's, uh, 76, uh, it was a march? No. Did you work in brass bands much?
